---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What do you want to do

Describe the workflow or outcome you want.

## Why

What problem does it solve? Who benefits?

## Suggested approach (optional)

If you have an idea how it could work, describe it. If not, skip.

## Alternatives

Are there other ways to achieve the same result? Does another tool
do this well?

## Scope check

CapRust is deliberately small and social-first. Current non-goals
(see README): professional NLE features, cloud sync, mobile,
Linux-first UX.
